purpose: Convert MODELLED economics into buyer-proof machinery. The first real buyer response becomes part of the evidence ledger (per Article XXVI — no self-certification).
constitutional_basis: Article XXVIII — modelled economics cannot be silently promoted to economic proof. The buyer questionnaire is the gate between MODELLED and VERIFIED.
the_machine_principle: Every economic claim in every TTP must trace to a buyer-verified response to this questionnaire. Until the buyer fills it out, the claim stays BUYER_UNVERIFIED. After the buyer fills it out, the claim becomes BUYER_VERIFIED (with the buyer's name and date attached to provenance).

questionnaire.question: For your specific patient population, what is the annual rate of shunt obstruction (not infection, not over/under-drainage — specifically obstruction)?
questionnaire.format: percentage of implanted shunts per year
questionnaire.why_we_ask: We modelled 30-50% obstruction rate from literature (Hydrocephalus Association, NIH NINDS). Your rate may differ by patient age, shunt type, follow-up duration. We need your number to compute your specific economic value.
questionnaire.evidence_claim_being_verified: P-01: '30-50% of shunts fail from obstruction'

questionnaire.question: What is your fully-loaded cost per shunt revision surgery (including hospital stay, surgeon fee, imaging, follow-up, complications)?
questionnaire.why_we_ask: We modelled $30K-$50K from industry estimates. Your cost depends on country, insurance structure, complication rate, hospital efficiency. We need your number for accurate ROI calculation.

questionnaire.question: What is your current standard of care for shunt obstruction? (e.g., reactive revision surgery only, prophylactic replacement at fixed interval, imaging surveillance, etc.)
questionnaire.why_we_ask: Defines the baseline against which P-01's value is measured. If you already have a partial solution (e.g., imaging surveillance), P-01's marginal value is lower.

questionnaire.question: If you acquired P-01, how would you deploy it? (e.g., integrate into existing product line, new product, replace current flagship, target specific patient segment)
questionnaire.why_we_ask: Defines the deployment scenario for economic modeling. Different deployment strategies have different ROI.

questionnaire.question: Based on the simulator results (P-01_PROTOTYPE/05_simulator.py), do you believe the predicted reduction in obstruction rate (from 30-50% to ~5-15%) is plausible in your patient population?
questionnaire.why_we_ask: Tests whether the buyer accepts the simulator's falsification finding (graceful degradation, not strict dual-invariant) as a basis for economic modeling.
questionnaire.evidence_claim_being_verified: P-01 simulator: peak ICP 22 mmHg, 5/5 survive (vs 0/5 baseline)

questionnaire.question: What is your annual implant volume (new implants + revisions)?
questionnaire.why_we_ask: Required for total addressable market calculation.

questionnaire.question: Based on your answers to Q-01 through Q-06, what is your verified annual avoided cost if P-01 prevents X% of obstructions? (We will compute this with you, not for you.)
questionnaire.why_we_ask: This is the ECONOMIC PROOF we seek. Once buyer verifies this number, the package's economic claim transitions from MODELLED to BUYER_VERIFIED.

questionnaire.question: Based on your verified annual avoided cost, what is your willingness-to-pay for the P-01 technology package (control law + reference implementation + test protocol + IP dossier)?
questionnaire.why_we_ask: Tests whether our $500K indicative price is in the right order of magnitude. If WTP << $500K, we need to either reduce price or strengthen package. If WTP >> $500K, we may be underpricing.

what_happens_after_buyer_responds: Buyer's response is added to COMMERCIAL_EVIDENCE_LEDGER.json as a new entry with status=BUYER_VERIFIED
Original MODELLED claim is NOT deleted — it remains as the 'pre-verification' state, with a pointer to the verified version
If buyer's verified numbers differ significantly from modelled numbers, the TTP's economic model is updated (with version bump)
The first buyer response is a MAJOR state transition: it moves the package from 'internally modelled' to 'externally engaged'
constitutional_basis_for_each_question: Article XXVI — buyer's response is independent verification, not self-certification
Article XXVII — every threshold (cost, rate, volume) has explicit provenance (buyer's actual data)
Article XXVIII — modelled economics cannot be silently promoted to economic proof; buyer verification is the gate
honest_disclosure: We do NOT expect the first buyer to fill this out completely. The questionnaire is the framework. The first conversation will likely fill out Q-01, Q-02, Q-06 (basic facts) and leave Q-04, Q-05, Q-07, Q-08 for follow-up. That is fine — partial verification is still better than zero verification.
